value.rationale: The 4-cube is canonical and its 32-edge graph metric has a genuinely intermediate radius-two scale. The result gives a complete homotopy filtration with an unexpected mixed-dimensional (3,5) sphere wedge, all integral homology and every field barcode. The Sq2 computation settles a real Hopf-attachment ambiguity not answered by homology alone; reproducible exact finite certificates make this a motivated standalone fact.
